RFDose

introduction.Rmd
library(RFDose)

Overview

RFDose is an R package designed to estimate personal radio-frequency electromagnetic field (RF-EMF) doses. It takes into account different device types and tissues, as well as exposure from far-field sources.

Goals

  • Provide reproducible RF-EMF dose estimates based on user input variables and pre-defined parameters.

Theoretical Background

The calculations in this package are based on Jalilian et al (publication in writing stage).

Customizing Parameters

By default, RFDose uses a pre-defined parameter list. However, it is possible to override these parameters. If you would like to do so, please follow these steps:

# Example use
print("Insert use example here!")
#> [1] "Insert use example here!"

Generated output and documentation

Running the {r}calculate_emf_doses() function returns a data frame with a column containing the dose for each exposure source and tissue, as well as the total dose (which is simply the doses of each exposure source added together for a particular tissue).

# Example use
print("Insert use example here!")
#> [1] "Insert use example here!"

In addition, in the future {r}calculate_emf_doses() will also generate a log file that records the parameters used in the calculations and the number of missing variables that were replaced by default variables.
